Warranty:

Our rain jackets and pants come with a limited 6-month warranty that covers manufacturing defects only, starting from the date of purchase.

What’s Covered
This limited warranty protects the original purchaser against:

  • Defects in stitching
  • Faulty zippers or buttons
  • Manufacturing-related issues with seams or fabric assembly

If a manufacturing defect is confirmed, we will either repair or replace the item at our discretion.

What’s Not Covered
The warranty does not cover the following:

  • Leakage or seepage of water through fabric, seams, zippers, or ventilation areas
  • Damage resulting from normal wear and tear, misuse, abrasion, accidents, or exposure to extreme environmental conditions
  • Fading or discoloration of fabric due to sunlight, storage conditions, or washing

Please note that rainwear is water-resistant, not waterproof under all conditions. Water ingress during prolonged exposure or under pressure (e.g., during heavy rain or high-speed riding) is not considered a manufacturing defect.

Important Notes:

  • Warranty is valid for the original purchaser only and is non-transferable.
  • All shipping costs for sending the product to our facility will be borne by the customer. If your claim is approved, we will ship the repaired or replaced item back to you at no extra cost.

We strive to ensure that your experience with our rain gear is dependable and hassle-free. If you have any questions about your product or this policy, please don’t hesitate to contact us.

Features

      What’s Covered:

      • Manufacturing defects in stitching, sole bonding, or buckles
      • Premature failure of Velcro, straps, or closure systems
      • Material separation under normal riding use
      • Faulty shank, footbed, or internal padding due to manufacturing issues

      If a valid manufacturing defect is confirmed, Raida will repair or replace the boots at its sole discretion subject to their approval.

      What’s Not Covered:

      • Damage from crashes, falls, or impact during off-road use (these are protective, not indestructible)
      • Wear and tear from normal or aggressive riding
      • Sole wear from gear shifting, walking, or footpegs
      • Damage caused by water immersion, pressure washing, or drying under direct heat

      • Leather or PU discoloration, fading, or wrinkling due to sun, water, or sweat
      • Mold or odor caused by storing boots when damp
      • Improper fit, comfort issues, or stiffness after use (break-in time varies by rider)
      • Unauthorized modifications or third-party repairs
